data.authority: build bookkeeping only; not release approval
risks: Lease exclusion applies within the selected DB; copies are not a cross-root distributed lock.
Fencing cannot kill a live worker or prove its external effect stopped; unknown outcomes require explicit reconciliation.
The journal is append-only through its API, not protected against a hostile local DB writer.
Interrupted artifact/export writes may leave partial files; automatic orphan overwrite and general recovery are intentionally absent.
Gate remains independent; Windows loopback isolation is unresolved and measure-only stays REVIEW.
GitHub writes are blocked: existing account ebrahimism received HTTP403 for the owner-provided repository.
